purpose: Executable allowlist of disposable G0 lab targets. Any lab command that touches a target MUST resolve it here first; an entry absent from 'targets' or with authorized=false cannot be executed against. This file authorizes local synthetic targets only; it does not authorize production access, cloud APIs, paid trials or any Selectel resource.

authorization.basis: Owner instruction in CR-001: autonomous G0 work starting with a local-only synthetic lab.
authorization.remote_execution: requires a separate explicit assignment and a coordinator-run profile

resource_budget.network: no external egress; loopback or isolated namespace only

allowed_address_classes: documentation ranges only for role identifiers: 192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24, *.example.com, *.example.test, *.invalid

topology_roles.description: WordOps source server stand-in; holds synthetic sites
Target holding the restore site plus two neighbor sites
WOVault control-plane stand-in; runs checks and staging

targets.name: local-sandbox
targets.reset: delete and recreate the task-owned workspace under lab-output/; never touches tracked files
targets.cleanup: lab/tools/labctl.py cleanup --apply removes only paths inside lab-output/ listed in lab/resources.json
targets.notes: Runs on the implementer's machine as an unprivileged user. Provides real namespace isolation evidence, not a VPS or a WordOps environment.

pending_targets.name: wov-g000-containers
pending_targets.notes: Container execution is owned by the coordinator; this environment has no Docker socket. Entry documents planned roles only. labctl refuses to execute against pending targets. Activation requires the coordinator to move the entry into 'targets' with authorized=true after confirming the cleanup plan.

pending_targets.name: wov-g000-vps-pair
pending_targets.notes: Real disposable VPS targets need a separate explicit assignment with named addresses, budget and cleanup approval. No cloud credentials or Selectel resources are authorized.
